newsitem.title: USA: Texas jury awards no money in Sequa suit.
newsitem.headline: Texas jury awards no money in Sequa suit.

text.p: A jury in Texas district court on Tuesday rendered a mixed decision in Sequa Corp's Chromalloy Gas Turbine Corp lawsuit against United Technologies Corp's Pratt & Whitney unit for alleged monopolistic practices, but awarded no money to either side, a court spokesman said.

The spokesman for state district judge John Specia's court told Reuters the jury ruled unanimously after a three month trial that Pratt & Whitney did not try to run Chromalloy out of business, but did try to create a monopoly in replacement parts for jet engines, both of which were alleged in the Sequa Corp suit.
At the same time, it also found Chromalloy negligent in some respects, the spokesman said.
"Both sides kind of won and both sides kind of lost. But the bottom line is no one got any money," the spokesman said.
